message.content: The kernel implements the gemmlowp double-rounding arithmetic via 64-bit limb manipulation. Rather than proving the limb algebra analytically, I'll record a claim that the fused Triton arithmetic may deviate from the contract's exact two-stage definition (especially tie handling and extreme values), then test against `reference()` on adversarial inputs including exact-tie cases.
